title: Her rooms on A deck (the promenade deck): R3, a sourced table of facts
written: 2026-11-20, by the R3 session (Claude Opus 5.5), under docs/research/RESEARCH_rooms_plans_licence_v1_1_2026-11-20.md, on the coordinator's word after D deck and the orlop
rules: Facts only: which room, where, how big, which door to which. No image or drawing of any plan is kept. Every row cites the reference read and the original checked, or says it was not checked. Bets are tagged as bets.
reference: ET: Encyclopedia Titanica's free deck plans, A deck (https://www.encyclopedia-titanica.org/titanic-deckplans/a-deck.html; drawn by Bruce Beveridge for Titanic The Ship Magnificent, The History Press 2008), read on the page in the built-in browser on 2026-11-20, nothing saved
original: Shipbuilder 1911: The Shipbuilder, Midsummer 1911 (the Olympic and Titanic number), its plate of the promenade deck (A), as reproduced by GG Archives (https://www.ggarchives.com/OT/Titanic/25-ImageLibrary/TheShipbuilder-10-Design-SpecialPlates.html); too small to read room by room, not opened this time.
how: Walls by her frames, as on C and B decks: the plan's scale from its own frame ticks (30.85 px a frame: 0.0975 ft a pixel), the midship section placed by the printed 6, 8, 10 and 12 aft of it, a ruler of her frames drawn over the page; the plan's printed 80 and 76 aft fall on it. Walls read against the ruler at 1:2 (to about a frame) and 1:1; the house's sides, corridors and passages by pixel profiles at 1:1 (rows tagged 'profiled').
Frames to feet: E deck's anchors (data/rooms/E_deck.json). A deck runs from 88.5A (its after edge) to 80F (its forward edge); the house on it from 84.4A to 76.7F.

y: feet from the centreline, port positive, at 0.0979 ft a pixel. 'shell+' and 'shell-' are her side; in metres the tool puts it at the model's half-breadth halfway between A deck and the Boat deck [stand-in for the edge of the promenade deck, at 46 to 47 ft on the plan].

Rows: the house's rooms, casings, stairs and corridors, and the promenade as strips between the house and her side, one strip each side beside each part of the house. The plan draws the promenade alike from end to end; it marks no glazed screen. The model counts the promenade as space only forward of its screen's after end (TIER.screen, 14.1 m, about 15.9F); the strips aft of it are tagged 'beyond the model'.
No watertight bulkhead reaches A deck; the table's bulkheads is empty.

Doors: 2 ft 3 in by default [bet]; the plan names double sliding doors, revolving doors and sliding doors, without sizes. Stairs are listed among the doors with no width. The windows the plan writes (patterns A to H, sizes and counts) are in the rows' plan fields.
Derived fields (x_m, y_m, poly_m, area_m2, zone, slab, plan_compartment) are written by: node tools/rooms_table.js --write data/rooms/A_deck.json

frames.note: E deck's anchors (her frames, feet forward of amidships).

bulkheads.note: None: no watertight bulkhead reaches A deck, and the reference marks none.
